name: Job alerts: Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby boards -> filter -> dedupe -> Telegram

parameters.content:
## Job / opportunity alerts (original)
Daily 07:00: pulls public job boards of the companies you list (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby public APIs, no keys), filters by title keywords, locations and freshness, flags roles whose text mentions visa sponsorship, drops roles already sent, and posts a Telegram digest.
It never applies for you.

assignments.name: sponsorship_terms
assignments.value: ={{ ["visa sponsorship", "sponsor visas", "relocation support", "skilled worker visa", "highly skilled migrant", "blue card"] }}
